name: explore_bet_valid
summary: Exploration spec for 10-point belief allocation across 2-5 objects and 2-4 features with valid time and budget.

charter.question: When listeners allocate 10 points across candidate referents in scenes spanning 2-5 objects and 2-4 features, do their full belief distributions follow depth-1 RSA with a multi-cue structural prior, singleton-only bounded-depth RSA, informative feature parsimony, or depth-2 recursive inference?

instructions.welcome: Welcome! In this short study, you will play a communication game where a speaker describes one of the objects on the screen.
instructions.task: On each turn, you and the speaker see the same row of objects. The speaker has one target object in mind and says a single word that names a part on their target object. Your job is to split 10 points across the objects (using whole numbers that add up to 10) to show how likely each object is to be the speaker's target. Give more points to objects you think are more likely, and 0 points to objects that do not have the named part. On some turns, the speaker's word was cut off; on those turns, split your 10 points across the objects based on which object you think the speaker is most likely to talk about.

comprehension_checks.question: How many total points must you split across the objects on each turn?
options: 10 points in total across the objects

comprehension_checks.question: How many points should you give to an object that does not have the part named by the speaker?
What should you do on turns where the speaker's word was cut off?
options: Split 10 points across the objects based on which one you think the speaker is most likely to talk about
